summary: Anthropic announced a second $20 million donation to Public First Action, bringing total support to $40 million, to fund public education and advocacy for AI safety policy including transparency requirements and tighter export controls on advanced chips.

mechanisms.reason: Anthropic states it supports policy efforts to tighten export controls on advanced chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, which if enacted would restrict trade in this hardware.
mechanisms.quote: we support policy efforts to tighten export controls on advanced chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment and to curb illicit model access and distillation attacks

categories.reason: Advocacy for tighter export controls on advanced chips would, if adopted, restrict chip sales to certain jurisdictions, affecting logic chip makers' addressable markets.
categories.quote: tighten export controls on advanced chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment

categories.reason: The announcement explicitly names semiconductor manufacturing equipment as a target of tightened export controls advocacy.
